properties.name: selection_mode
properties.comment: One selected item, or an extended selection with Shift and Ctrl (SelectionMode). Switching to one keeps only the active (or first) selected item and raises selection_changed when that drops others.

table.description: One selected item, or an extended selection with Shift and Ctrl.

hand: written narrows a multiple selection to one item through apply_selection

properties.name: top_index
properties.comment: The first visible row (TopIndex); a view onto the list's scroll position. Zero in an empty list; otherwise an index outside the items throws std::out_of_range. Item edits and making a row visible move it.
hand: a view onto top_index_, which the list moves itself without hooks (item edits, ensure_visible during arrange; the flush settles their damage); write_view keeps set_top_index's refusal and invalidation

properties.name: item_height
properties.comment: The height of each row before text scaling (ItemHeight), 12 to 256 (std::invalid_argument otherwise). coerce_item_height may rewrite a write after that check.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ListBox item height must be finite and between 12 and 256");

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The rows' font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("ListBox font specification is invalid");

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: a collection; stays methods (W owns collections)

not_properties.name: selected_indices
not_properties.reason: selection state changed through select_index and clear_selection
